jobs.occupation: Visual Inspection Expert (m/f/d) for Automated Inspection & Machine Vision (Ingenieur/in - Automatisierungstechnik)
jobs.description: Would you like to combine cutting-edge machine vision technology with pharmaceutical manufacturing and help shape the future of automated inspection processes? As a Visual Inspection Expert (m/f/d), you will play a key role in the development, optimization, and implementation of automated visual inspection systems for our parenteral products. Working in an international environment, you will collaborate closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, and external technology partners.Your Responsibilities- Take technical ownership of automated visual inspection systems for parenteral products as well as container integrity testing systems- Develop, optimize, and standardize inspection recipes, lighting concepts, camera parameters, and image-processing algorithms- Plan and support feasibility studies, FAT/SAT activities, commissioning, qualification, and validation projects for new or modified inspection systems- Define and evaluate defect catalogues, test sets, and challenge sets, and analyze inspection data and defect rates to continuously improve system performance- Assess new technologies and supplier solutions in the fields of machine vision, camera-based inspection, industrial image processing, data-driven process monitoring, and integrity testing- Act as a subject-matter expert and collaborate closely with international stakeholders, suppliers, and regulatory authoritiesYour Qualifications- University degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics/Optics, or a comparable technical discipline- Several years of professional experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, equipment engineering, industrial image processing, or a similarly regulated environment- Strong hands-on experience with automated visual inspection systems, machine vision applications, or camera-based inspection technologies, combined with a solid understanding of optics, lighting, and camera systems- Ideally, knowledge of GMP requirements, qualification and validation activities, as well as experience in data analysis, statistical evaluation, and structured deviation management- Familiarity with automation, system interfaces, data handling, and computerized systems; experience with machine-learning or deep-learning models for visual inspection is an advantage- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a structured way of working, and the ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly and effectively to different audiences- Good German and excellent English communication skills, as well as a willingness to travel internationally and support on-site activitiesOur offerWe offer an exciting working environment and a position that can serve as a springboard for further career development within our company. At the same time, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to improving the quality of life of patients around the world.As a collectively bargained employer, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, including employer-funded pension and accident insurance, free employee parking, employee discount programs, a subsidized cafeteria, occupational health services, and many additional benefits.Drive the future of Global Engineering – join #futurefresenius and apply now through our online portal to make an impact!ContactPlease apply through our online portal.Apply now (https://apply.jcd.de/Apply.php?iJobAdID=109243&tc=3-11)Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung
